generationMode: one edit call; generated PNG copied byte-for-byte; no resize, processing, or reroll
prompt:
Image 1 is NPC079's complete 3x3 lower-half mouth reference grid; Image 2 is the original NPC079 portrait for identity, native lip scale, geometry, soft palette, and pixel texture. Return one complete 3x3 atlas of whole lower-face halves only. Each equal cell represents the original native 64x29 lower half, with the same framing and proportions as Image 1. Preserve exact row-major order A, B, C / D, E, F / G, H, X. No margins, labels, gutters, borders, or extra cells.

Create nine restrained neutral speech mouth poses at the original small lip scale. A and X are closed neutral mouth poses; keep them visually closed and as close to the original lips as possible because the final neutral A/X will be copied from the immutable original. Make B through H distinct, moderate viseme shapes, with natural small changes in lip opening and rounding: include slight opening, rounded O-like opening, medium vertical opening, wider horizontal opening, a restrained teeth-visible opening, and other clearly distinct but plausible speech shapes. Avoid huge mouths, oversized teeth, exaggerated jaw drop, smile, frown, emotional expression, or dramatic color/contrast changes.

Change only the lips and immediately necessary inner-mouth pixels. Keep the same NPC face, skin shading, nose, chin, jaw, neck, hair, background, crop, lighting, soft muted palette, and native-scale pixel clusters unchanged in every cell. Preserve lips at exactly the original position and size. Keep the rest of each entire 64x29 lower-half cell intact. Do not blur, smudge, smooth, add makeup, add details, text, or alter framing.
